messages.en:
So I got this letter from 
those tyrants at the
{ff 00 00 02}Happy Room Academy{ff 00 00 00}.
They gave me {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}
points {ff 00 00 00}or somethin',
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}I think{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 14 00}they said
something about my room
lacking any cohesion.{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 15 00}Who do they think they are,
anyway? {01 00 00 05 00}Seriously,
{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Nii et ma sain selle kirja 
neilt türannidelt
{ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu Akadeemiast{ff 00 00 00}.
Nad andsid mulle {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}
punkti {ff 00 00 00}või midagi,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}Ma arvan{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 14 00}nad ütlesid
midagi selle kohta, et mu
toas pole ühtsust.{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 15 00}Kelleks nad end üldse
peavad? {01 00 00 05 00}Tõsiselt,
{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
So a couple of days ago I
get this letter from the
{ff 00 00 02}Happy Room Academy{ff 00 00 00}...
{07 14 00}This time, {01 00 00 05 00}they give my
room {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} points{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Yeah, now who's laughing?
Eat that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
Nii et paar päeva tagasi
sain ma selle kirja
{ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu Akadeemiast{ff 00 00 00}...
{07 14 00}Seekord {01 00 00 05 00}andsid nad mu
toale {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} punkti{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Jah, kes nüüd naerab?
Söö seda, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
I got this letter the other
day from the {ff 00 00 02}Happy Room
Academy{ff 00 00 00}...{ff 00 00 02}
{ff 00 00 00}{07 14 00}They say my room has some
kind of cool Fungus Sway 
infection, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0a 00}My little fungus earned me
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} points{ff 00 00 00}, and even
some cool stuff!
messages.et:
Ma sain teine päev selle
kirja {ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu
Akadeemiast{ff 00 00 00}...{ff 00 00 02}
{ff 00 00 00}{07 14 00}Nad ütlevad, et mu toas on
mingi lahe seenestiil, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0a 00}Mu väike seen teenis mulle
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} punkti{ff 00 00 00} ja isegi
lahedat kraami!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}The colors in my room are
pretty much the most 
amazing thing ever.
{07 03 00}Even the {ff 00 00 02}Happy Room
Academy {ff 00 00 00}gave me {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}
points{ff 00 00 00}! {0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mu toa värvid on peaaegu
kõige hämmastavam asi 
üldse.
{07 03 00}Isegi {ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu
Akadeemia {ff 00 00 00}andis {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}
punkti{ff 00 00 00}! {0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}The oppressive{01 00 00 05 00} {ff 00 00 02}Happy Room 
Academy{ff 00 00 00} is finally giving
me some love, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
I think it's because I
bought a lot of the same
kind of stuff.
They gave me {01 00 00 0f 00}{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}
points{ff 00 00 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Rõhuv{01 00 00 05 00} {ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu 
Akadeemia{ff 00 00 00} annab lõpuks
mulle armastust, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Ma arvan, et sellepärast,
et ma ostsin palju
sama sorti kraami.
Nad andsid mulle {01 00 00 0f 00}{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}
punkti{ff 00 00 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I got this letter from 
those {ff 00 00 02}Happy Room Academy 
{ff 00 00 00}people, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}This time, they gave me
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} points{ff 00 00 00}.

I guess I had just one
piece of furniture that
wasn't beneath them!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 01 00}How dare they!{07 00 00} They didn't 
even tell me which one
they liked, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma sain selle kirja 
neilt {ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu Akadeemia 
{ff 00 00 00}inimestelt, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Seekord andsid nad mulle
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} punkti{ff 00 00 00}.

Vist oli mul ainult üks
mööblitükk, mis polnud
nende jaoks alandav!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 01 00}Kuidas nad julgevad!{07 00 00} Nad ei
öelnud isegi, milline neile
meeldis, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
So I guess it's not so bad
being a member of the 
{ff 00 00 02}Happy Room Academy{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 0e 00}But I still don't really 
understand them{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}I mean, how dare they tell
me I've got bad taste!
{07 05 00}How dare they?!
messages.et:
Nii et vist polegi nii halb
olla {ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu Akadeemia{ff 00 00 00}
liige.
{07 0e 00}Aga ma ikka ei saa neist 
õieti aru{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}Kuidas nad julgevad öelda,
et mul on halb maitse!
{07 05 00}Kuidas nad julgevad?!
